svg.title: FB_Valve2 - test V4: bistable valve, disable holds the spool, the movement timer pauses
svg.text: FB_Valve2 - test V4: bistable valve, disable holds the spool, the movement timer pauses
xEnable FALSE (e.g. valve supply off by the safety zone, or module not allowing motion): both coils off, the spool keeps its position, the tMove counter does not count.
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
ticks 2-5: moving to B, n = 1..4 ; ticks 6-19 disabled: coils off, n frozen at 4 ; ticks 20-24: n = 5..9 (900 ms < 2000 ms) -> no alarm, B reached at tick 24 ;
tick 35: command A while disabled -> busy but no coil ; tick 38 enable -> qSolA ; tick 41 at A. Total counted time 0.9 s although 2.2 s passed - correct, the valve had no air/coil.
